about_the_game:
The Spooky Express original soundtrack will immerse you in the weird and wacky world of Trainsylvania where all manner of ghoul and goblin are waiting to make your acquaintance.

These strange and spooky songs feature many live instrumental performances! You’ll hear everything from singing saw and washtub bass, to clarinet or mandolin.


Composed & Produced by Priscilla Snow

Additional credits:
Violin, Clarinet, and Whistling arrangement by Jack de Quidt (Tracks 9 & 12)
Mandolin arrangement by Nate Davis (Track 15)
Album cover by Adam deGrandis

2025 Copyright Draknek & Friends
